questions.q: What stays on the flight controller rather than the companion?
questions.explain: Stabilization, navigation, failsafe, mixer: whatever the aircraft would crash without goes on the FC.
The FC checks the geofence, the battery, the EKF and executes or refuses.

questions.q: The companion hung in flight. What is the correct aircraft behavior?
options: Waits forever at the last target
questions.explain: GUIDED timeouts and the GCS failsafe are part of the design.

questions.q: Which platform for telemetry on a screen and setup from a phone?
questions.explain: A microcontroller with Wi-Fi: instant boot, milliwatts.

questions.q: Where should you power the companion from?
questions.explain: The telemetry port isn't rated for a computer's current.

questions.q: The ArduPilot companion port speed for 10–50 Hz streams:
What must the FC survive when the companion fails?
options: Only a broken UART, the rest doesn't matter
A hang, a reboot, a broken link
questions.explain: This is tested by pulling the UART in SITL/on the bench.

questions.q: What is the component_id of an onboard computer in MAVLink?
questions.explain: The companion is a separate component 191 of the same system.
